product.description: The 3.5mm (1/8") stereo TRS connector is more commonly known as the Headphone Jack on portable mp3 players and mobile phones. This cable features a male 3.5mm stereo (TRS) plug on one end and a female stereo (TRS) jack on the other end, each with molded connector housings and strain relief boots.
